answer: At first firing the trimmer works at the potyard, stacks the shelves at dawn and seals the door before the pots cool. The throwing is vouched by Zebrawood thong drumstamper drumloft seal: a seal thong drumstampers press twice drumloft peg tallies hold. While trellis shapes the vase, marble centers the clay and forge centers the pot. A slack jar never holds glaze: 71887 slack jars and 71887 slack pots must answer for it.
